# AD Nail Spa

> Brazilian nail studio based in Round Rock, Texas. Adri Dallabrida's private nail studio in downtown Round Rock: Russian manicures, long-lasting gel, extensions and waterless pedicures, with coffee on and no rush.

## Services
- Gel manicure: Russian-technique cuticle prep, then gel polish cured under UV for a high-shine finish that lasts. Clients say they've never had lifting or chipping.
- Structured gel overlay: Strength for fragile, brittle or uneven natural nails, with no added length. It's the “blindagem” you'll see all over Adri's Instagram.
- Regular manicure: Classic polish chosen from a whole wall of colors, from Colorama reds to soft nudes. It lasts up to 7 days and is easy to change.
- Waterless pedicure: No soaking. Disposable liners, callus smoothing, hydration and a foot massage, finished in regular or gel polish.
- Nail extensions: Instant length with Gel-X, or sculpted hard gel on dual forms for durable, lightweight, natural-looking nails.
- French & finishes: Regular or smile-line French, chrome, cat eye and simple nail art, added to any manicure or pedicure.

## About
AD Nail Spa is Adriane “Adri” Dallabrida's private studio: Suite 2 at 110 S Lampasas St in downtown Round Rock. A cream wall lined with polish, brass sconces, a tall wavy gold mirror, and her certificates framed in black above it all. Adri is Brazilian, and she works alone, so every appointment is just you and her. Her specialty is the Russian manicure: precise cuticle prep for a clean finish and gel that lasts. Clients also come for structured gel on their natural nails, extensions, waterless pedicures and classic reds. She takes hygiene seriously. Tools are cleaned, individually packaged and sterilized in an autoclave, and pedicures use disposable liners instead of a soaking tub. What clients mention most: she takes her time, she gets every detail right, and there's always coffee, water and a snack waiting.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through AD Nail Spa's booking page: pick your service and a time. You can also call (512) 769-9237. It's a one-artist studio, so every visit is by appointment.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Tuesday 1 to 7 p.m., Wednesday to Friday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Saturday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Closed Sunday.
- Q: What is a Russian manicure?
  A: It's Adri's specialty: a precise cuticle-prep technique that gives a very clean finish around the nail and helps gel and polish last longer. Clients with very sensitive cuticles say they had no issues at all.
- Q: How much is a gel manicure?
  A: A gel manicure is $55 and takes about an hour and a half, including hand hydration and a massage. A regular manicure is $45. The full menu is on the Services page.
- Q: Is the pedicure done in a foot bath?
  A: No. Adri's pedicures are waterless: no soaking, with disposable liners, callus smoothing, hydration and a foot massage.
- Q: Can you remove gel or acrylic from another salon?
  A: Yes. Gel polish removal is $10, and acrylic, hard gel, polygel, SNS or extension removal is $20. Removal only, so add a manicure if you want a new set.
